name: Volunteer at Shady Grove Medical Center
org: Adventist HealthCare Shady Grove Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Rockville hospital. You might greet visitors at the information desk, help patients and families, support nursing units, do office projects, or work in the gift shop.
who_can_apply: Volunteers ages 15 and older. The page lists no residency rule.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Call the Office of Volunteers to ask about openings.
how_to_apply: Call the Office of Volunteers at 240-826-6111 to learn how to join.
notes: The page does not list a teen-only program or which roles teens can do. The hospital's Stepping Stones shadowing program needs two years of college, so it is not for high schoolers.
